bio.text: Paul A. Gosar, D.D.S., represents Arizona's 9th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and was first elected in 2010.
Before entering Congress he owned a dental practice in Flagstaff for 25 years.
He serves on the House Committees on Natural Resources and on Oversight and Government Reform.
